# dsh-review-threads
Persistent, GitHub-style review threads for DeepSeek Harness diffs.

`dsh-review-threads` takes over the official `changes-review` tab and keeps the
official turn diff d

ata source. A Review is bound to a diff and owns many
line-level Threads. User draft changes become

visible to AI only when the user
submits a Review. AI can add comments immediately, but cannot delet

e or resolve
threads.
## Status

Version `0.1.1` is the current release. DeepSeek Harness itself remains in preview,
so review the co
mpatibility range before installing.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.1` through `0.2.1`
- Node.js 22.18 or newer

## Install

Restart the profile after installation. Removing the plugin restores the
official Review tab; review
data stays under the profile's DSH storage.
## Review commands

- `/review` opens the current working-tree changes, including untracked files.
- `/review <base>..<h

ead>` opens a committed revision range. Use
`/review <base>...<head>` for merge-base comparison.
- A

ppend `-- <paths...>` to limit either comparison to repository paths.
- Use `/review bind <base>..<h

ead>` to open a range whose patch matches the
current session's working Review; confirm the bind in

the panel.
- `/review-diagnostics` reports storage counts without comment bodies.
- `/review-clear-d
rafts` discards unsubmitted drafts in the current session.

The command only opens the Review panel. It does not send a conversation
message or start an AI turn

Creating a non-prerelease GitHub Release for a tag matching the package version
runs `.github/workfl

ows/publish.yml`. The workflow verifies the repository,
builds the package, and publishes through th

e npm Trusted Publisher connection;
no npm token is stored in GitHub.
